issues.summary: The new method should be public and properly documented, since what it returns and how to use it (especially with CUDA graphs) is subtle.
The generator lock should be released right after this line instead of being held longer than needed.
Add a test showing what happens when the offset overflows int64.
Don't build a new Tensor from another Tensor's data_ptr; use clone() for a fresh copy or alias() for a view.
